verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents project alert rules that fire on error frequency and send emails or call a webhook URL (glitchtip-docs-29, glitchtip-docs-4). Uptime monitors also trigger email or webhook alerts when a ping is missed (glitchtip-docs-7). However, the only documented actions are notifications, with no general rule engine for other automated actions such as auto-assign, auto-resolve or custom workflows. Missing for 10: rule conditions beyond error frequency, a broader set of triggered actions beyond email/webhook notification, detailed rule-configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
